author: /root
scope: Four existing final-record leaves × JA/CN/TW = 12 corrections.

review.method: Compared all four Korean leaves and 12 accepted targets with both full choices and all three inline slot sources and alternatives.
review.findings: Three addresses, about 30 minutes, phone quiet/paper sound versus screen heat/no look, no purchase press or order screen and absence at the consultation desk are preserved. Final JA2/CN2/TW1 edits clarify the button action in all three locales and notification motion in JA/CN.

preservation.proof: Three canonical receipts and accepted values match final responses; reversal restores all three previous overlays and the complete prior ledger.

validation: Pure check_batch and final accepted-check/accepted-import VALID with empty stderr. Earlier responses and checks remain historical. No engine.

identity.encoding: Raw canonical JSON basename-sorted [basename,bytes,sha256]; rows [locale,id,source-hash,previous-target-hash,target-hash] in export order.
